title: Moonlit Archway Vista
description: A stylized painting viewed through a cracked stone archway, revealing a vibrant night scene. A large weeping willow stands on rocky shore beside a cobblestone path leading to a pond with white lotus flowers, its reflection visible in the glowing blue water under a radiant yellow sun or moon against a purple and blue sky with a distant city skyline.
prompt: Stylized painting of a serene night landscape viewed through a broken stone archway. A large black weeping willow tree stands on the rocky shore next to a cobblestone path leading to a blue pond filled with white lotus flowers. The water reflects a bright glowing yellow sun or moon in a vibrant purple and blue sky with clouds. Distant white city skyline with domes and spires on the horizon. High contrast, bold outlines, stained glass aesthetic.
